sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops the app's analytics, attribution, and audience-measurement services.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Signs in with Google through GmsCore instead of Google Play services.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Removes the Donate link from Top Stories and the Donate card from the account screen.
Hides an active VPN from the app's checks on the phone.
Makes the app see a Wi-Fi connection when the phone is on mobile data.
Sends the app's network traffic through a proxy you choose, such as Orbot or a VPN service's SOCKS5 server.
Removes the ads and sponsored rows in the feed and articles, the sticky banner, and the ads before videos.
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
